checks.reason: The tested cloud workspace could not fetch actions/setup-python@v7 without authentication. Original synchronization.yml jobs test-runtime, validate-metadata, validate-publication-readiness, validate-build-reproducibility, validate-arxiv-packaging, validate-release-lifecycle and validate-version-sync retain that provider-action wiring gap. The selected local runtime workflow calls the same install/test commands; direct checks do not prove setup-python or artifact upload behavior.

build-paper.yml/build, build-magazine.yml/build, paper-quality.yml/build+lint+magazine-consistency and beacon-compatibility.yml/package require their publication toolchains, additional producer pins and/or Docker actions. These are outside the scoped Python local runner and need separate explicit selection and qualification; native paper artifacts are preserved.

reuse.yml/reuse-lint and commitlint.yml/lint-commits use additional provider actions. Commit lint also needs a meaningful PR/base/head event. They are not exercised by the selected runtime job and must not be inferred from its result.

pages.yml/build+deploy; publication.yml/detect-scope+validate+validate-reuse+audit-chktex+build-paper+build-arxiv+build-magazine+package+release; release-paper.yml/release; release-please.yml/release-please; release-tag.yml/tag; bump-version.yml/bump; copilot-setup-steps.yml/copilot-setup-steps are excluded from this validation allowlist. They contain provider services, publication/branch mutations or provider-specific setup and require separate workflows and authority.
